cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Seznámit s koncepcí nemoci dřevin a ekologické nestability lesních ekosystémů. Významem stresů jako příčin poruch, chorob a napadení entomofágy. Seznámit s významnými druhy hmyzích škůdců, jejich kontrolou a obranou proti nim, s přístupy integrované ochrany.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Ústní zkouška a zápočet. Zápočet je udělen za seminární práci a absolvování hlavního cvičení. Pro úspěšné absolvování zkoušky je nezbytné prokázat vyvážené znalosti z oblasti biotických, abiotických i antropogenních škodlivých činitelů, prokázat schopnost syntézy a aplikace, případné souvislosti s navazujícími předměty ovlivňující stabilitu lesa (těžba, pěstování lesů, hospodářská úprava lesů etc.).

en.label: Prerequisites:
en.content: State Bachelor Examination
Theoretical forest protection: conception of a disease, health, the use of the theory of stress, theory of the stability of forest ecosystems, the spiral of decline. (allowance 0/0)

Types of stressors and their effects: atmosphere and air pollution, types of air pollution, transmission, photochemical reactions, immission/pollutants, important effects of deposition, subsequent soil processes, effects on plants and their autotrophic and heterotrophic parts, integrated model of the effect of air pollution. (allowance 0/0)
Climate and weather effects, temperature variations, wind flow, waterlogging, drought. Soil, physical condition, toxicosis, nutrient deficiency, deficiency phenomena. (allowance 0/0)
Tree decline, dominant causes, typical manifestations at dominant species, attitude to the "tracheomycosis disease" of trees. (allowance 0/0)

Bionomics, ethology, control/monitoring, control of the statutory pests of spruce (Ips typographus, Ips amitinus, I. duplicatus, Pityogenes chalcographus, Polygraphus polygraphus and other bark beetles on spruce, sawflies on spruce, Cephalcia abietis, Hylobius abietis), pine (Ips sexdentatus, I. acuminatus, weevils, longhorn beetles, flat-headed borers and important defoliators such as Lymantria monacha ), oak and other broadleaved species (bělokaz dubový and bělokazi on elm, Tortrix viridana, looping worms/inchworms, Lymantria dispar. (allowance 0/0)
Pests of seeds and pests in forest nurseries, harmful rodents. (allowance 0/0)

Expected development of the forest health condition, global climatic change and its impact on forest, civilization stress, problems of forest fragmentation, present and ingoing problems, premature disintegration of the forest, threat/danger to trees and their stands, system solution. (allowance 0/0)

Planning the measure -- based on an assignment for a concrete area to prepare a plan of control measures for the given harmful species: annual report on the situation of harmful agents, selection of instruments/means, organization of the measure, safety precautions, checking the measure effectiveness. (allowance 0/0)
Training (allowance 0/0)

en.label: a.
en.content: Expected development of the forest health condition, global climatic change and its impact on forest, civilization stress, problems of forest fragmentation, present and ingoing problems, premature disintegration of the forest, threat/danger to trees and their stands, system solution.

en.label: b.
en.content: Forets protection surveys, annual reports on the condition of harmful agents, specification of a seminar paper -- protection within forest management planning, information of forest protection included in OPRL (Regional Plan of the Development of Forests), LHP (Working Plan, Forest Management Plan), legal regulations, making a report, cooperation with LOS.

en.label: c.
en.content: Symptoms of damage to trees -- abiotic factors (frost, heat, precipitation...), air pollution.

en.label: d.
en.content: Risks of the origin of abiotic damage to the forest -- characteristics of windbreak damage (wind speed, bending moment, tree stability, effect of rot on the tree stability, risk places, classification of stands according to their threat), origin and effects of icing, monitoring the air pollution stress, zones of risk/threat , forest monitoring of the forest condition.

en.label: e.
en.content: Planning the measure -- based on an assignment for a concrete area to prepare a plan of control measures for the given harmful species: annual report on the situation of harmful agents, selection of instruments/means, organization of the measure, safety precautions, checking the measure effectiveness.

en.label: f.
en.content: Pesticides -- the list of admissible preparations, a law on phytosanitary care and resulting duties for a forest manager, principles of the selection of means, most often used means and their specification, planning a concrete measure -- determination of a means, dose, calculation of necessary quantity, the proposal of technical means/devices.

en.label: g.
en.content: Planning an aerial measure -- duties, procedures and preparation of a measure for a particular area.

en.label: h.
en.content: Determination of bark beetles -- determination of imagoes of bark beetles according to a key.

en.label: i.
en.content: Game damages -- rights and duties of a forest manager, determination of damage, evaluation of the damage, application of compensation for damage including calculations for an actual area.

en.label: j.
en.content: Fires -- origin, causes, statistics, organization of a measure, aerial firefighting (water bombing), prognosis of fires including calculations, concrete assignment for the given area.

en.label: k.
en.content: Control methods -- practical procedures including the control of selected species -- false spruce webworm (Cephalcia abietis), larch casebearer (Coleophora laricella) or oak leaf roller moth (Tortrix viridana).

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with the conception of tree diseases and ecological instability of forest ecosystems. The importance of stress as the cause of disorders, diseases and entomophage attacks. To acquaint students with important species of insect pests, their control and protection from them, approaches to integrated protection.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Oral examination and assessment. Credit is awarded for the essay and the completion of the main field exercise. For successful completion of the exam, it is necessary to demonstrate a balanced knowledge of biotic, abiotic and anthropogenic harmfull factors, demonstrate the ability to synthesis and application of any connection with the related subjects affecting the stability of the forest (logging, forest management, forest treatment etc.).
